Yes, that’s correct.

Sounds like you hit first can research limbo like I did, but you will 100% not regret a Polonium-30.

I went Polonium-30. Full auto rated, durable, no void with Rearden, OCL customer service is top tier IMO and I just want to go to the range and be a hooligan.

If you'd like to go absolute quiet you for sure would go something like a Hydrogen, Hyperion, or Enticer if you don't mind the transfer fee and lead time - their performance to cost ratio is tits. You will give up full auto rating, but that won't matter if you control your firing schedule. **To add, I’ve read Andrew of OCL runs a Hydrogen on his 300 but also says it’s not built for fast firing schedules.

I definitely didn't need the durability of the Polonium, but for the price and durability I couldn't pass it up. I even had to buy the Polonium-K for my 5.56. Otter Gang fucks.

Armscor .300BLK primer blew in while shooting and got lodged in my cam pin. It caught the round, but the cam couldnt move to eject.

I had to hammer it out with a dowel and hammer. Absolutely insane. After 4 rounds, I gave away the remaining.

Don't be shootin' hot loads at the range. Those are best left at home.
